hooks.text: No website on your Google Maps listing? Losing bookings daily.
Your homestay’s biggest credibility mistake: missing a website link.
Myth: Google Maps alone drives guests. Reality: A website seals trust.

posts.linkedin:
Google Maps gets you discovered, but a missing website loses trust.

Browsing homestays across Himachal, I noticed a repeating issue: great Google ratings, but the website field is completely blank.

When a guest taps that profile on a phone and finds no official page, friction creeps in. They hesitate, open an aggregator app, or compare three other properties where room photos and contact details are clear.

To solve this, I designed a mobile-first demo concept for a homestay:
- Room visuals that load smoothly on standard mobile data
- Clear amenities without clutter
- A sticky WhatsApp button for direct questions

No bulky booking software—just an easy path for guests to reach the host directly without commission fees.

If you manage a stay, clinic, or local shop, DM 'DEMO' and I'll send over the sample page. You pay only after you approve the work.

video.hook_first_3s: Google Maps gets you seen, but a website gets you booked. (Text: Maps = Visibility | Website = Trust)
video.voiceover: Google Maps gets you seen, but a website gets you booked. Most guests check reviews, then look for a site to verify the rooms and trust the host. Here is a clean, fast site I built for a Manali homestay to bridge that gap. DM 'Site' to fix your trust gap.
shots: 0-3s: Screen record of Netlify deploy log, finger taps the live URL
3-8s: Fast mobile scroll of the Manali homestay homepage showing high-res images
8-12s: Quick cut to the CMS editor changing a room description in real-time
12-15s: Final scroll to the 'Book Now' button on the mobile view
video.flow_prompt: Create a high-retention 15-second vertical video. Start with a raw screen recording of a Netlify deployment transitioning into a live mobile website for a Manali homestay. Use fast cuts between the live site scroll and the backend CMS editor to prove authenticity. No stock footage, no talking head, and no generic graphics. The audio should be a clean, honest voiceover with raw ambient clicking sounds from the screen recording.
